correctness.rationale: For the precisely defined loopless Pólya threshold graph, direct Laplacian eigenvectors give lambda*_j=j Z_j+sum_{l>j} Z_l for j>=2. The last-zero index proves {kappa_n>=k} iff its last k creation bits equal one (k<=n-1), with complete graphs giving kappa_n=n. Beta(a,b) de Finetti mixing yields exact P(E_n)=(a)_k/(a+b)_k and posterior P|E_n=Beta(a+k,b); k/n->theta makes n(1-P) tend Gamma(b,rate theta). Prefix defect-indicator Laplace functionals give a mixed Cox Poisson process on [0,1-theta]; only O_p(1) defects perturb the reflected eigenvalue positions, while all nondefect normalized eigenvalues approach one. Mixing a Poisson((1-theta)Y) count gives NB(b,theta); nested suffix events give survival (theta/s)^b and complete-graph atom theta^b at one. Independent finite graph spectral and exact-rational beta checks corroborated premises, not the weak convergence itself.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks do not replace the stated infinite proof or establish correctness of assumptions outside the precise theorem domain.
